name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 2 No 49

clue.text: I’m 19 with energy to burst in
To make mash right one weekend a pepper is required
Not all bookish commendation makes an indistinct impression
Captivated for a little while by spring
Ignominious failure — as if going off at half-cock?
Prospect for gold in an American republic
Constant letters from Peter and Paul
Start of nonsense article that is extremely silly
Boats in a lake elsewhere providing king with fish
Compile an anagram: cop in male form
A clown who is unpleasant getting laid off
Children in centre of labyrinth, captured by Cretan ruler
Hobble to pole with explorer
Some paintings do go back in the gallery
European city centre with a secure retreat
A saint tucked into fodder and ate sumptuously
Lime as a cure for uneasiness?
Ground swells
Misrepresent alliance of princess and revolutionary communists
Three-toed sloth and fish in poor health
Reading or writhing in river
Kipling’s book about Poles — and endless relation
Let not passion sway philosophers
Controversial post-free claim
To hear’s possible in this
Huge people lodged in rebuilt semi
Contract in a game
Being vocal, a liar conceals loss of speech
Beverage, for example, imported by students’ union
